title: Italian-Style Semolina Empanadas
description: A unique twist on traditional Italian desserts, these semolina empanadas are fried to perfection and perfect for sweet treats.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine semolina, flour, Parmesan, egg, sugar, and vanilla extract.
Gradually add the melted butter and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Cover the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Place a tablespoon of confectioners' sugar in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Heat about 1-2 inches of oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat until it reaches 375°F.
Fry the empanadas in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the empanadas on paper towels and dust with confectioners' sugar.
